introduction: Massachusetts WIC provides food and nutrition support for eligible pregnant or postpartum people, infants and children under five. An online pre-application starts contact with a local clinic.

who: Massachusetts residents in a qualifying pregnancy, breastfeeding or postpartum category, and children under five.
A nutrition need and qualifying household income are required.
Current MassHealth, SNAP or TAFDC participation establishes income eligibility, while other WIC requirements still apply.
sections.get: Food support, nutrition education and help connecting with health services. Clinic staff assess each participant’s needs.
sections.docs: Bring income proof, Massachusetts address proof and identity for each applicant. Recent pay records or proof of a qualifying benefit can document income. Contact the clinic if you cannot obtain a listed record.
sections.apply:
1. Use Apply for WIC online on the state page and provide a telephone number, or call the nearest clinic.
  2. You can also call 800-942-1007 to arrange an appointment.
  3. Complete the clinic assessment and follow its instructions for participation.
sections.after: The online form is a pre-application; a representative contacts you to complete the process. Confirm appointment time, who should attend and the documents needed before visiting. Keep clinic contact information for benefit or nutrition questions.

faqs: Can a father or guardian apply for a child?
A parent or legal guardian may apply for a child under five.
Does SNAP automatically enroll my child in WIC?
It establishes income eligibility, but WIC has its own application and assessment.
The state says its services are free.
Is the online form final approval?
It begins the pre-application process; a representative follows up.
Can I arrange an appointment outside normal work hours?
Ask the clinic; the state lists evening and Saturday appointments at many locations.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
